subject.title: feat(linux): Quick Chat streamed replies and precise pairing states

question: Should Linux Quick Chat support BTW side-question replies in the same streamed reply area, including their `chat.side_result` event path, rather than treating only ordinary `chat` events as user-visible output?
rationale: The mechanical forwarding fix is clear, but the durable native UX contract for side-question output belongs to the Linux Quick Chat product owner and is not settled by the ordinary-stream screenshots.

options.title: Support all visible reply variants
options.body: Recommended: normalize `chat.side_result` into the same correlated Quick Chat reply flow and cover it with a focused gateway-event regression test.

options.title: Exclude BTW replies explicitly
options.body: Keep the bridge limited to ordinary chat only, but document and surface a clear alternate destination for BTW replies instead of rendering a blank completed state.

recommendation.title: Support all visible reply variants
recommendation.body: Recommended: normalize `chat.side_result` into the same correlated Quick Chat reply flow and cover it with a focused gateway-event regression test.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Linux Quick Chat feature series and its native gateway event bridge are authored by this contributor.
